question: Do real, original partially observable Memory Gym tasks provide enough action-conditioned public observation and reward evidence to support a later frozen causal/temporal knowledge learner, and does public memory-guided state/action exploration produce more informative experience than equal-step random and balanced controls?
hypothesis: A transparent tokenless action-conditioned transition memory that favors novel public visual state-action pairs may increase unique encountered observation signatures relative to both passive controls, but no improvement is assumed and this is not a trained policy superiority test. Absent robust reward or reproducible action-outcome signal, stop before any expensive GRU/model science.
avoid_overlap: Do not modify FKP10 source/PR; pull pinned exact upstream benchmark independently on a fresh FKP11 branch. Do not duplicate the original FKP10 970100..970103 mechanical actions or claim source first-use.

source.observable_data: Only reset()/step() returned public image array, selected valid MultiDiscrete([3,3]) action, finite reward and termination/truncation. No environment source-private targets, info, layouts, privileged orientation, hidden step counter or memory-gym internals into model.

arms.curiosity: After 9 identical public warmup action-pairs per seed, use a bounded map of the last publicly observed state fingerprint and each of 9 actions to outcomes; prefer actions not yet tried at current fingerprint, with global source-action counts as deterministic tie-break. State fingerprint is 8x8 uint8 intensity grid derived from public observation only. No deep learned weights or advertised native integration.
arms.balanced: After identical 9-step warmup, cycle through all nine action pairs by public step number; never consult outcomes to choose the next action.
arms.random: After identical 9-step warmup, choose action pairs from a deterministic frozen independent per-seed PRNG, without public feedback or source-private state. Same maximum step cap.

metrics: Public source-native actual steps, nonzero reward events, total reward and terminal success per task and arm; zero reward is informative negative, never claim success from image novelty alone.

Per episode count of unique 8x8 public observation intensity fingerprints and repeated-state count; action–conditioned seen transition records vs held-out transitions, record state-action revisits; distinguish observation novelty from environment reward.

Paired-by-seed 10,000 fixed-seed-9090 bootstrap 95% CI on curiosity minus balanced and curiosity minus random for unique state fingerprints, and on reward sums, separately by task. No source-private labels.

End-to-end wall/CPU, memory keys/bytes, action counts and identical upstream SHA/Blobs/clean tree on each OS. Cross-platform per-policy action/reward/observation trace SHA-256 must match exactly or SOURCE/DETERMINISM_FAIL.

Strong-model comparison with fully trained conventional recurrent GRU, numerical memory ablations and real retention is NOT part of source admission and must be separately frozen & qualified before any claim of scientific superiority.
positive_development_signal: Curiosity must improve mean unique public state fingerprints by >=10% relative to BOTH balanced and random on BOTH tasks, with context/seed-paired 95% CI lower >0, WITHOUT a lower reward rate/step on either task. This only classifies as DEV_SOURCE_INFORMATION_SIGNAL, NOT SCIENTIFIC_PASS. Source can be useful without hitting this threshold if environmental reward observations are adequate.
no_go: If zero nonzero rewards on all three policies in a task, or public observation trace differs cross-OS after same pinned original upstream, stop causal learning first-use. If curiosity fails the positive threshold, log negative and do not tune it on exposed DEV seeds.
first_use_guard: Only public DEV 971000..971007. Original FKP10 admission seeds 970100..970103 are consumed. Protected original training, transfer and negative worlds are NOT opened. Precommit exact code and methods before DEV runs; qualify fixture negative tests and root/G29 before original DEV.
qualification: Exact research SHA/tree, prereg-first commit, unchanged upstream source+blobs, source fixture tests Linux/Windows, inherited 54 root and 4 G29 tests on both OS, one original DEV trial and Windows replay; never confuse science, CI, or deployment.
conclusion_rule: Interpret as source signal only. Real GRU/strong baseline science and actual Yggdrasil native integration remain separate. Do not post-score tune DEV or merge main merely for a source survey.
